subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` intentionally expose metadata for transcript-mentioned paths outside the workspace, or should the workspace rail avoid red Missing badges while preserving the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The remaining blocker is a product/security boundary choice: the user-facing bug is real, but the PR's raw stat fallback changes what metadata the Gateway may reveal outside the configured workspace.

options.title: Restore Workspace Boundary
options.body: Keep session-file metadata behind fs-safe and fix the UI/API semantics by filtering or neutralizing external paths without raw outside-root stat calls.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned external paths, but require explicit maintainer security acceptance plus protocol and UI tests.

options.title: Split The PR
options.body: Land or rely on the focused layout fix separately and send the backend Missing-label semantics through a narrower review path.

recommendation.title: Restore Workspace Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep session-file metadata behind fs-safe and fix the UI/API semantics by filtering or neutralizing external paths without raw outside-root stat calls.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate across the original rail merge and recent current-main history for the affected Gateway/UI surface.
